lessons.title: Algorithmic Bias & Fairness
lessons.description: Examine how training datasets reflect and amplify human historical biases, and study mathematical definitions of algorithmic fairness.

lessons.title: Explainability & Interpretability (XAI)
lessons.description: Open the neural network black box using SHAP values, LIME, saliency maps, and attention attribution techniques.

lessons.title: Safety, Alignment, & Hallucination Mitigation
lessons.description: Tackle the Alignment Problem, catastrophic reward hacking, jailbreaking risks, and output guardrails.

lessons.title: Autonomous Agents, Tool Use & AGI
lessons.description: Explore the frontier of AI: the ReAct loop, LLMs using APIs/code interpreters, multi-agent swarms, and the path to AGI.
